name: Tokiwa Shizuku
source:
Full of energy, a younger sister who loves her older brother.

[url=/c62808]Yuu[/url]'s cousin. She is always smiling and friendly and is liked by many people. Although she loses to her older sister [url=/c60992]Marina[/url] in style and figure, she is said to be a big-breasted loli character due to her short height. Unlike her sister, she always shows off that she loves her brother.
